name: Sustained service

name: Recoverable sortie

description: Make battery choice and installed mass transparent.

name: Reviewable recommendation
description: Trace the recommendation to repeatable calculations and assumptions.

name: Prepare relay sortie
description: Review request, choose configuration, check declared gates. Reject dispatch if a gate or required operational evidence is missing.

name: Establish service
description: Climb, transit, and establish. Unsuccessful establishment ends service attempt and prompts intended recovery.
postcondition: Station reached and both hops established

name: Sustain relay service
description: Relay A-to-B traffic while monitoring resources. Physical service delivery is not simulated.

name: End service and recover
description: Return horizontally and descend at base. Off-nominal recovery is a described responsibility.

name: Restore readiness
description: Inspect and replace/recharge pack as appropriate. No turnaround-time model.

name: Clear and adequate service hops
description: For each declared service hop, the analysis shall require clearance margin at least 0 m relative to the wall top plus 5 m and link margin at least 10 dB above the -90 dBm assumed receiver threshold.
requirement_text: For each declared service hop, the analysis shall require clearance margin at least 0 m relative to the wall top plus 5 m and link margin at least 10 dB above the -90 dBm assumed receiver threshold.

name: Requested service duration
description: Under the declared continuous-service assumptions, the analysis shall require energy-supported relay dwell of at least mission.dwell_s (baseline 900 s).
requirement_text: Under the declared continuous-service assumptions, the analysis shall require energy-supported relay dwell of at least mission.dwell_s (baseline 900 s).

name: Mission energy and reserve
description: For each option, planned mission energy plus reserve shall not exceed nominal_energy_wh times usable_fraction. Reserve is reserve_fraction of usable energy.
requirement_text: For each option, planned mission energy plus reserve shall not exceed nominal_energy_wh times usable_fraction. Reserve is reserve_fraction of usable energy.

name: Gross mass ceiling
description: For each option, installed gross mass shall not exceed vehicle.max_gross_mass_kg (baseline 5.5 kg).
requirement_text: For each option, installed gross mass shall not exceed vehicle.max_gross_mass_kg (baseline 5.5 kg).

name: Continuous bus power
description: For each option, the highest modeled segment bus demand shall not exceed vehicle.continuous_bus_limit_w (baseline 1400 W). Transients remain unassessed.
requirement_text: For each option, the highest modeled segment bus demand shall not exceed vehicle.continuous_bus_limit_w (baseline 1400 W). Transients remain unassessed.

name: Declared installation interfaces
description: The architecture shall specify I1–I5, their load and connection assumptions, and evidence gaps before a configuration is accepted for physical implementation.
requirement_text: The architecture shall specify I1–I5, their load and connection assumptions, and evidence gaps before a configuration is accepted for physical implementation.

name: Comparable alternative records
description: The study shall report pack and gross mass, usable and reserve energy, energy margin and maximum supported dwell for each of the six options.
requirement_text: The study shall report pack and gross mass, usable and reserve energy, energy margin and maximum supported dwell for each of the six options.

name: Reproducible provenance
description: Each generated study shall preserve resolved inputs and their SHA-256, state provisional physics and evidence status, and identify the calculation source.
